title: Check rows (columnar)
description: Per-check result rows in columnar form with string dictionaries. Row-of-objects JSON at 2,000 rows is mostly repeated key strings; columnar is roughly 5x smaller and trivially decoded client-side.

dict.description: Column name -> ordered value list. Integer cells in `rows` index into these.

columns.description: Must include base_approve_rate, cf_approve_rate and k -- comparison is rate-based over k trials, so the UI can render '4 of 5 trials flipped' rather than a bare boolean.

notes.description: test_id -> note, for rows needing a caveat (e.g. repair_implausible: income clamped at plausibility bound).
